source_title: UDOT Oversize Non-Divisible Load Provisions (Rule R909-2 Size & Weight)
verify_reasons: UDOT provisions page and fee-schedule page fetched this run, but the single-trip/overweight fee amounts are published as images on the fee-schedule page; the $30 oversize / $60 oversize+overweight single-trip figures are from UDOT's published summaries — confirm current amounts with UDOT Motor Carrier (801-965-4892).
Escort thresholds differ between Interstate/freeway and other highways; the matrix below merges them (conservative), noting Interstate may require fewer — confirm per route.
Overweight over 125,000 lbs GVW is priced by UDOT's weight/distance fee table (rounded up to next increment), not a flat number.

superload_thresholds.note: Loads over 17' wide, 17'6" high, or 300,000 lbs are processed Monday-Friday 8am-5pm MST only and may take up to 14 days for Regional clearance. Routine permit gross reaches ~148,500 lbs on 7 axles; loads over 19' high may require a route survey.

width.note: other highways: 1 escort over 12' wide (Interstate: no escort until 14')
other highways: 2 escorts over 14'; Interstate: 1 escort over 14', 2 over 16'
other highways: up to 3 escorts over 16'; Interstate: 2 escorts over 16'
over 17' wide (secondary) or 20' (all highways): 2 escorts plus certified police/Highway Patrol escort

height.note: over 17'6" high: 2 escorts plus Highway Patrol and utility notification

single_trip.fee_formula: Single-trip oversize permit $30 (96-hour validity); single-trip oversize+overweight $60. Overweight over 125,000 lbs GVW priced by UDOT's weight/distance fee table (weights/miles rounded to next increment). A UDOT-provided escort is $40 or the full cost of a UDOT employee and vehicle, whichever is greater.
single_trip.note: Single-trip permit valid 96 hours; also issued semi-annual/annual.

annual.note: Semi-annual and annual permits available for qualifying non-divisible/divisible moves; fees per UDOT schedule.

movement_restrictions: Superloads (over 17' wide, 17'6" high, or 300,000 lbs) processed Mon-Fri 8am-5pm MST only, up to 14 days for Regional clearance
Metropolitan commute-hour and holiday restrictions may apply per permit and route
notes: Legal width 8'6", height 14'0", GVW 80,000 lbs; superload processing requires advance Regional clearance.
Overweight over 125,000 lbs is weight/distance-priced (axle-dependent), so a gross-weight-only verdict is indicative — confirm the UDOT quote.
State-level rules only; local permits and bridge-specific engineering out of scope.
